visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand, adorned with a silver chain bracelet and a gold ring, holds a smartphone in a vertical orientation against an outdoor street backdrop. The screen displays a video call interface showing a toddler in a white shirt sitting on a light-colored sofa indoors, with two small windows showing two women. (2) The scene cuts between a close-up of the phone screen and a shot of a woman in a denim jacket and a 'Talking Heads' t-shirt who is laughing and covering her mouth with her hand. Yellow and pink text overlays with heart icons appear on the screen intermittently. (3) The toddler is shown in close-up on the phone screen, touching his face and looking at the camera with a curious expression. He later puts his hand on his cheek, mimicking a 'cupping face' pose, while colorful emojis and variety-style text boxes pop up around him. (4) The toddler points to his eye and then waves his hand rapidly toward the camera. The video concludes with the smartphone screen still visible, showing the toddler's face as he says goodbye, followed by a playful heart-break emoji overlaying the women's reactions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic pop background music starts with bright guitar strumming. A female voice with a friendly, high-pitched tone asks the child if he misses her. A faint handling noise is briefly audible as the camera adjusts. (2) A child's voice replies with high arousal, prompting immediate, energetic laughter from two female voices. The background music maintains a cheerful rhythm throughout the interaction. (3) The female voices continue to interact with the child using animated, high-pitched tones, encouraging him to perform actions. Short digital 'pop' or 'ding' sound effects are used for emphasis during the video edits. (4) The dialogue turns to identifying facial features, with the child repeating words like 'nose' and 'eyes' clearly. The child abruptly says 'bye-bye', leading to a final burst of loud laughter from the women as the music track concludes.
